name: THOMAS CHACRA
tagline: Environmental bioengineer, management systems and audit documentation
addressee: To the QHSE recruitment team, DEME Group, Zwijndrecht.
subject: Application: QHSE Engineer Trainee (R0003875), Thomas Chacra
paragraphs: Safety and environment are the same discipline wearing two names. Both come down to whether the paperwork describes what actually happens on site, and whether anyone checks. I have spent my working life on the environmental half of that sentence, and the QHSE traineeship is the first place I have seen where the two are trained together rather than bolted onto each other.

My grounding is in management systems rather than in operations. I have worked through the requirements of ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 in gap analyses against real company practice, built the environmental indicators and monitoring KPIs that sit inside those systems, and created a Power Automate system that digitalised a document audit trail so the evidence landed in the right folder instead of someone's inbox. I have also worked on data quality control and validation, which is unglamorous until the day an auditor asks where a number came from.

What I do not have is site experience. I have not run a risk assessment on a vessel, investigated an incident, or worked a rotation offshore, and I will not pretend those are small gaps. They are the reason I am applying for a traineeship and not for a QHSE coordinator role. What I can offer is a fast learner who already reads standards comfortably, one who will not be intimidated by an audit, and who is genuinely willing to travel and work in rotation. My English is C1 and my French is native; Dutch is the obvious gap and I would start on it.
I would welcome a conversation about the rotations, and I am glad to hear your feedback either way.
